people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
translations.bsb: and she saw two angels in white sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and the other at the feet.
